name: Varka's Secret Stash of Cash
description:
Money Varka has set aside for drinks, brazenly tucked away in a desk drawer.
"The most dangerous spot is actually the safest spot!" He might claim that, but the truth is he probably keeps the money here because he believes the acting Grand Master will neither spend it nor reveal its hiding place.
Although this money was originally set aside to buy the Dandelion Wine as an offering to the Archon, now that plans have changed, maybe it can be used to reward the Honorary Knight who saved Varka — or given to the knight to reward each friend who helped rescue Varka instead.
